Because download_type is a grouping key, groups with other download_type return 0; if the group’s download_type is “first-time download” and all counts are NULL, the result is NULL. - redownloads: sum counts only when download_type equals “redownload” (case-insensitive); other rows contribute 0. Groups with other download_type return 0; if the group’s download_type is “redownload” and all counts are NULL, the result is NULL. - total_downloads: sum counts only when download_type is “first-time download” or “redownload” (case-insensitive); other rows contribute 0. Groups with other download_type return 0; if the group’s download_type is one of these and all counts are NULL, the result is NULL. - deletions: sum counts only when event equals “delete” (case-insensitive); non-matching rows contribute 0. Result is 0 if no delete rows exist in the group; if every row in the group is delete and all counts are NULL, the result is NULL. - installations: sum counts only when event equals “install” (case-insensitive); non-matching rows contribute 0. Result is 0 if no install rows exist in the group; if every row in the group is install and all counts are NULL, the result is NULL. - Sums ignore NULL counts; duplicate source rows accumulate. - Non-metric columns are carried through exactly as the grouping keys.'

- name: int_apple_store__territory_install_deletions
      description: Aggregates install and delete counts by app_id, date_day, territory, source_type, and source_relation.
      grain: One row per app_id, date_day, territory, source_type, source_relation
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_apple_store__app_store_installation_and_deletion_daily
      business_logic: 'Group the staging data by app_id, date_day, source_type, territory, and source_relation (no filtering). For each group: - installations: sum counts only for rows whose event equals "install" using case-insensitive comparison; rows with other event values or NULL event values contribute zero. If there are no "install" events, the result is 0. If all matching "install" rows have NULL counts and the group contains no non-matching rows, the result is NULL. - deletions: sum counts only for rows whose event equals "delete" using case-insensitive comparison; rows with other event values or NULL event values contribute zero. If there are no "delete" events, the result is 0. If all matching "delete" rows have NULL counts and the group contains no non-matching rows, the result is NULL. Duplicates within a group are accumulated by summation. No ordering or rounding is applied. Columns used from source: app_id, date_day, source_type, territory, source_relation, event, counts.'
      columns:
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier; grouping key passed through.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Event date; grouping key passed through.
      - name: source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event source type; grouping key passed through.
      - name: territory

        description: Store territory; grouping key passed through.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream source relation; grouping key passed through.
      - name: installations
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total installs per group; matches 'install' case-insensitively; non-matches contribute zero; may be NULL only when all matching counts are NULL and no non-matching rows exist.
      - name: deletions

- name: int_apple_store__territory_report
      description: Dense daily spine from 2020-01-01 to CURRENT_DATE across distinct app_id/source_type/territory/source_relation combinations from Apple Store daily staging tables.

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__overview_report
      description: Daily app-level overview combining impressions, page views, downloads, installations/deletions, sessions, active devices, and crashes
      grain: One row per (source_relation, app_id, date_day) present in intermediate.int_apple_store__app
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__discovery_and_engagement_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__crash_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__download_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__installation_and_deletion_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__session_daily
      business_logic: '- Use all rows from intermediate.int_apple_store__app as the reporting grain to define the complete set of (source_relation, app_id, date_day) keys. - Aggregate per key: • discovery_and_engagement_daily: sum impressions and page_views. • download_daily: sum first_time_downloads, redownloads, and total_downloads (total_downloads is taken as provided, not recomputed). • installation_and_deletion_daily: sum installations and deletions. • session_daily: sum sessions and active_devices. - Take crashes from crash_daily at the same keys without further aggregation (source expected to be unique per key). - Left join each aggregated dataset to the reporting grain on all three keys. - Left join app_dim on (source_relation, app_id) to add app_name. - For all numeric outputs, replace NULL with 0 after joins. Sums ignore NULL inputs and include all contributing rows (no de-duplication beyond the grouping keys). - Output exactly one row per reporting-grain key.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system label from the reporting grain used as a join key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Day-level timestamp from the reporting grain used as a join key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier within source_relation used as a join key
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name from app_dim joined on (source_relation, app_id); NULL if no matching app_dim row
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions by (source_relation, app_id, date_day) from discovery_and_engagement_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: page_views
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of page views by (source_relation, app_id, date_day) from discovery_and_engagement_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: crashes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Crash count from crash_daily for the key; 0 if missing
      - name: first_time_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of first-time downloads by key from download_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: redownloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of redownloads by key from download_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: total_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of total downloads by key from download_daily (not computed from other fields); 0 if missing
      - name: active_devices
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of active devices by key from session_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of deletions by key from installation_and_deletion_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: installations
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of installations by key from installation_and_deletion_daily; 0 if missing
      - name: sessions

        description: Sum of sessions by key from session_daily; 0 if missing

references.name: intermediate.int_apple_store__app
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Use all rows from intermediate.int_apple_store__app as the reporting grain to define the complete set of (source_relation, app_id, date_day) keys. - Aggregate per key: • discovery_and_engagement_daily: sum impressions and page_views. • download_daily: sum first_time_downloads, redownloads, and total_downloads (total_downloads is taken as provided, not recomputed). • installation_and_deletion_daily: sum installations and deletions. • session_daily: sum sessions and active_devices. - Take crashes from crash_daily at the same keys without further aggregation (source expected to be unique per key). - Left join each aggregated dataset to the reporting grain on all three keys. - Left join app_dim on (source_relation, app_id) to add app_name. - For all numeric outputs, replace NULL with 0 after joins. Sums ignore NULL inputs and include all contributing rows (no de-duplication beyond the grouping keys). - Output exactly one row per reporting-grain key.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__platform_version_report
      description: Daily Apple Store metrics by platform_version and source_type built at the reporting grain; missing measures default to 0.
      grain: One row per (app_id, date_day, source_type, platform_version, source_relation) present in intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_report
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_impressions_pv
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_app_crashes
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_downloads_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_install_deletions
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_sessions_activity
      business_logic: '- Establish the reporting grain as all rows from intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_report keyed by (app_id, date_day, source_type, platform_version, source_relation). - Build app lookup from intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim selecting (app_id, app_name, source_relation). - Aggregate per-grain metrics within each intermediate source: - impressions/page_views: sum impressions, impressions_unique_device, page_views, page_views_unique_device grouped by the five keys. - downloads: sum first_time_downloads, redownloads, total_downloads grouped by the five keys. - installs/deletions: sum installations, deletions grouped by the five keys. - sessions/activity: sum sessions, active_devices grouped by the five keys. - Crashes: take values from intermediate.int_apple_store__platform_version_app_crashes at the same five-key grain; this dataset is expected to be unique per key. - LEFT JOIN each aggregated dataset and crashes to the reporting grain on an exact match of the five keys; LEFT JOIN app_dim on (app_id, source_relation) to attach app_name. - For all numeric metric columns, if a join yields no match or NULL, return 0; no rounding or scaling; integer types preserved. - No filtering or ordering is applied; no deduplication beyond the described GROUP BY aggregations. The output contains exactly one row per reporting grain key, with app_name NULL if no matching app_dim record.'
      columns:

        description: Source system identifier from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:

      - name: date_day

        description: Reporting timestamp from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name joined from int_apple_store__app_dim by (app_id, source_relation); NULL if no match; casing preserved.
      - name: source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Traffic source category from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: platform_version
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Platform version string from reporting_grain; used in all joins; propagated as-is.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions over the five-key grain from impressions_pv; NULLs become 0.
      - name: impressions_unique_device
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of impressions_unique_device over the five-key grain from impressions_pv; NULLs become 0.
      - name: page_views
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of page_views over the five-key grain from impressions_pv; NULLs become 0.
      - name: page_views_unique_device
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of page_views_unique_device over the five-key grain from impressions_pv; NULLs become 0.
      - name: crashes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Crash count taken as-is at the five-key grain from app_crashes; NULLs become 0; dataset expected unique per key.
      - name: first_time_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of first_time_downloads over the five-key grain from downloads_daily; NULLs become 0.
      - name: redownloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of redownloads over the five-key grain from downloads_daily; NULLs become 0.
      - name: total_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of total_downloads over the five-key grain from downloads_daily; NULLs become 0.
      - name: active_devices
        data_type: HUGEINT

        description: Sum of deletions over the five-key grain from install_deletions; NULLs become 0.
      - name: installations
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of installations over the five-key grain from install_deletions; NULLs become 0.
      - name: sessions

The output contains exactly one row per reporting grain key, with app_name NULL if no matching app_dim record.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__subscription_report
      description: Daily subscription KPIs per product and territory; joins summary and events to the reporting grain and enriches with country names/regions; missing measures are zero-filled.
      grain: One row per date_day × vendor_number × app_apple_id × subscription_name × territory_short × state × source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report as the driver; output one row per key: date_day, vendor_number, app_apple_id, subscription_name, country (as territory_short), state, source_relation. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary on vendor_number, app_apple_id, date_day, subscription_name, country, state, and source_relation to bring active_* measures. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events on the same keys to bring event_* measures. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes on country_code_alpha_2 = reporting country; set territory_long to alternative country name when available, otherwise the standard country name; set region and sub_region from the match. - Pass through app_name and source_relation from the reporting grain; set territory_short from the reporting country and state from the reporting state. - Null handling: replace missing active_* and event_* measures with 0; geography fields from country_codes are null when no country match; other string fields are passed through unchanged. - No aggregation, sorting, or filtering is applied; row multiplicity follows the joins and assumes uniqueness of joined sources on the stated keys.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Day timestamp from the reporting grain; used in joins; no timezone conversion.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: vendor_number
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Vendor identifier from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_apple_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Application Apple ID from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name passed through from the reporting grain.
      - name: subscription_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subscription product name from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: territory_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Country name from country_codes: use alternative name when available, otherwise the standard country name; null if no country match.'
      - name: territory_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Two-letter ISO alpha-2 country code from the reporting grain; preserved as stored.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/province code from the reporting grain; may be null.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country_codes for the matched country; null if not found.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country_codes for the matched country; null if not found.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
      - name: active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on introductory free trials from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on pay-as-you-go introductory offers from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on pay-up-front introductory offers from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_standard_price_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions at standard price from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_standard_price_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: event_renew
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Renewal event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_renew >= 0
      - name: event_cancel
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cancel event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_cancel >= 0
      - name: event_subscribe
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Subscribe event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_subscribe >= 0

          data_type: VARCHAR

              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "NOT (app_version RLIKE '[A-Za-z]')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: device
          data_type: VARCHAR
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "device IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(device) <> ''"
              on_failure: delete_row
            - rule: "device NOT LIKE '%Android%' AND device NOT LIKE '%Samsung%' AND device NOT LIKE '%HUAWEI%'"

        - name: source_type
          data_type: VARCHAR
        - name: page_type

        - name: app_download_date
          data_type: DATE
        - name: territory
          data_type: VARCHAR
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "territory = UPPER(TRIM(territory))"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "LENGTH(TRIM(territory)) = 2"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: sessions
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: total_session_duration
          data_type: BIGINT
        - name: unique_devices
